summary: Build practical climate, ESG, finance, and agritech risk skills for agricultural value chains. Review the five-day course and enrol.
lede: Climate and ESG Risk Management across Agricultural Value Chains training helps organizations assess exposures that disrupt input supply, smallholder repayment, processing, exports, and buyer requirements. Using ISO 31000, GRI Standards, and practical value chain mapping, you will turn fragmented information into structured risk assessments and treatment priorities. You will develop a risk register, analyze smallholder finance scenarios, design continuity and control measures, compare guarantees, insurance, and blended finance, and organize ESG evidence. The course also guides you in building a Power BI or Excel dashboard and connected work products for credit committees, operational reviews, donor reporting, and executive decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or influence risk, finance, sustainability, trade, and programme decisions across agricultural value chains. It suits intermediate practitioners who can bring basic operational or financial experience into applied workshops.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in agribusiness operations, agricultural finance, sustainability, risk, export management, or development programmes. Basic spreadsheet skills and familiarity with budgets, portfolios, suppliers, or performance reporting will help. No coding or programming is required. Advanced agritech analytics, AI-assisted analysis, TNFD concepts, and sustainability-linked finance are addressed at conceptual awareness or operational application level, while risk registers, scorecards, control matrices, and dashboards receive hands-on treatment.
